ios.desc:
Create stunning portraits and master DSLR-level photography with AI-driven features that help you capture remarkable shots in any lighting condition.

NEW - Photo Coach: Your pocket portrait expert—blends ChatGPT's intelligence with NeuralCam's pro tools to guide you through composing, capturing, and perfecting professional portraits and other shots in real-time while building lasting skills.

Auto-mode for multiple features:
Auto-Portrait Mode: A fully AI-powered Portrait Mode without the limitations of the built-in portrait mode. Add professional depth to any portrait—works with all lenses, subjects, and distances, even in low light—with adjustable intensity for the perfect feel.
Auto Night Mode on All iPhones, All camera lenses with manual brightness optimization for skin tones
Auto AI Illumination: Brighter portraits without the flat HDR look
Quick-Editing mode: Perfect your portraits with a few taps before saving

AI & Classic editing controls:
AI Portrait Blur strength
AI Face Illumination strength
AI Style type and strength with skin tone preservation
Classic editing controls including exposure, contrast, shadows, highlights, and more

------ MAIN FEATURES: PERFECT PORTRAITS, NIGHT & DAY -------
Best-in-class Night Mode: The original NeuralCam feature - now optimized for portraits on All iPhones, All Cameras
Enhanced Daytime HDR: Capture brighter portraits with more detail and less noise
48 Megapixel AI Upscaled Photos: Professional-grade detail in every portrait
AI-Enhanced Macro Mode: Perfect for creative portrait details
Smart Color Grading: Elevate your portraits with AI styles based on professional photography
Auto-Remove People: Clean backgrounds for your portraits
Auto-Background Replacement: Studio-quality portrait backgrounds instantly
Lock screen Widget: Never miss the perfect portrait moment 
------- ADDITIONAL FEATURES -------

Auto and Manual Night Mode
Auto and Manual Daytime Mode
AI Enhanced Macro Mode (including Night Macro Mode)
Manual Computational Photography Controls
Multiple Capturing Modes: High Detail, Low Noise, Unprocessed
Merging of 1-12 frames
24MP & 48MP AI Super-Resolution
12MP AI Detail Enhancement
Multiple AI Brightening Modes - now including NeuralHDR specially tailored for daytime photos
Classic Manual Photography Controls for White Balance, Exposure, and Focus
Timer
Tripod Mode - allows longer exposure time in really dark situations
Gentle Torch - so you can lightly illuminate your scene if needed, in very low light
